defects.title: Mastra Code's observational-memory observer call completing mid-turn makes mastracode end the active ACP prompt with stopReason 'cancelled', drop its in-flight model request and exit the ACP server process, losing the user's task and all later steps of the session.
defects.expected_behavior: Finish every turn; an observational-memory observer call completing in the background must not end the active ACP prompt or terminate the ACP server.
defects.observed_behavior: Reproduced in 2 of 2 rounds on source 4206a2f7fe08. In each round, within 0.03-0.15 s of an OM observer call returning 200, mastracode ended the active prompt with stopReason cancelled ('ACP Agent cancelled the prompt') and dropped its in-flight main model request ('Client disconnected.'). Every later step failed with 'ACP adapter is closed' (R1 at step-4, R2 at step-5). No upstream error and no ABB cancel. Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (4206a2f7fe08).
